mn-aimags.geojson.description: 21 aimags + Ulaanbaatar, 22 features, built by merging the ADM2 (soum/district) units of the same source into their aimag so aimag and district outlines agree. Properties: code (NSO / 1212.mn), name (Mongolian), labelLat, labelLng.
processing: Downloaded the geoBoundaries gbOpen MNG ADM2 file (330 soums + 9 Ulaanbaatar districts).
Assigned each soum to the aimag it overlaps most (OpenStreetMap-derived ADM1 shapes used only as a spatial lookup; no ADM1 geometry is included), districts to Ulaanbaatar; dissolved per aimag.
Label point per feature = mapshaper interior point, rounded to 4 decimals. Output RFC 7946 GeoJSON, coordinates rounded to 1e-4 degrees.
Validated: 22 features, each 1212.mn code once; no self-intersections, overlaps or gaps; Ulaanbaatar matches the union of the district file within 1 km.

ub-districts.geojson.description: 9 districts (düüreg) of Ulaanbaatar, incl. exclaves Baganuur and Bagakhangai. Properties: code (NSO / 1212.mn), name (Mongolian), labelLat, labelLng.
ub-districts.geojson.upstreamSource: National Statistical Office of Mongolia; OCHA ROAP (HDX dataset mongolia-administrative-boundaries-polygon-polyline)

ub-districts.geojson.attribution: District boundaries: National Statistical Office of Mongolia and OCHA ROAP (CC BY 3.0 IGO), via geoBoundaries (Runfola et al. 2020, https://www.geoboundaries.org). Simplified and recoded.
ub-districts.geojson.citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0231866
processing: Selected the 9 Ulaanbaatar districts by geoBoundaries shapeID (names in the source are transliterated, e.g. Xan-Uul, Su'xbaatar, Bayanzu'rx; several names repeat as soums elsewhere, so shapeID was used).
Label point per feature = mapshaper interior point (this.innerX/innerY, same algorithm as -points inner), rounded to 4 decimals.
Matched to National Statistics Office (1212.mn) district codes and Mongolian names; all source properties replaced by {code,name,labelLat,labelLng}; written as compact JSON.
Validated: 9 features, each code once; no self-intersections; no overlaps or gaps (dissolve = 3 parts: main city, Baganuur, Bagakhangai, each 1 ring); each label inside its own polygon only.
